status: Concrete bounded missing-input proposal; unexecuted. Not a selected timing policy or proof that data coverage/matching will pass.
missingInput: Road-specific numeric speed limits with units/direction/linear scope and source provenance; connection/access/level context to screen unsafe road matches. Actual average speed and junction control/delay remain separate missing information.

source.manifestState: Must resolve, verify and freeze actual schema, object URLs, sizes and ETags/checksums before data ranges; no automatic latest-version fallback.

selection.rule: Every distinct origin in the 83 frozen unbuffered captures, sorted by (longitude,latitude); fixed +/-0.05 degrees bbox. All 21 windows retained, including empty/failed/stopped windows; no replacement or query-outcome filter. Windows are validation/data-feasibility coverage only and never runtime routing exceptions.
selection.spatialPredicate: subtype=road AND bbox.xmin<=east AND bbox.xmax>=west AND bbox.ymin<=north AND bbox.ymax>=south; retain complete intersecting segments/scoped properties and count statistics on their clipped in-window geometry. Dedupe returned objects by release/id/version across windows while preserving all window memberships.

enforcement: Freeze exact importer/parser/dependencies/fixtures and HTTP metadata/object allowlist before the live run. Keep tools in a separately pinned ignored environment, never app package dependencies.

All received HTTP bodies, including metadata/listings/footers/schema/tool wheels/ranges, pass one byte/request meter. Include redirects and failures; disallow unmetered library I/O, hidden extension downloads, credentials and paid query services. A bbox predicate or LIMIT alone does not enforce this cap.

Require verified ranged reads; reject ignored Range or changed object identity before consuming a full object. A controlled seekable range reader may feed a pinned Parquet reader; transport must be proven with synthetic tiny/oversized/redirect/truncated/range-ignored/identity-change fixtures.

Prove memory/disk/row/time guards enforceable on this host before data access. Stop at the first cap/error and retain every planned window status. Do not expand budgets, retry, switch release or replace a window.

Verify returned schema/object hashes and preserve complete scoped rules. Report missing, malformed, directional, conditional, variable, conflicting and partly scoped limits separately. Limits are not ETAs.
analysis: Coverage by window and road class, count and in-window geometry length, including zeros and unsupported/missing fields. Preserve complete source/license/version metadata.

On frozen cached detailed Census source geometry, report original-source-km-weighted limit and plausible-match coverage within each window. A geometrically plausible match is not verified road identity. Use predeclared <=25 m corridor, >=80% clipped source-length coverage and <=15-degree tangent difference; multiple passing candidates remain ambiguous. Retain all contrary cases and explicit source/grade uncertainty. No threshold tuning.

Only whole-span numeric limits applicable to ordinary motor-car travel in both directions without time/vehicle/use conditions count as usable for this first feasibility gate. Preserve every other rule, but do not flatten it into a model speed.
Report Natural Earth/base alignment and unresolved provenance separately; do not count representative chords as exact road geometry or merge them into the primary Census coverage denominator.

Independently review 50 asserted matches chosen by ascending SHA256(release/id/window), or every match if fewer than 50. Any definite wrong-road match fails matching readiness. No routing prediction, fit or accuracy evaluation.

goNoGo.dataReadiness: All 21 window ledgers complete within caps, frozen schema/source identities intact, all parser/provenance/scoping checks reconcile independently.
goNoGo.feasibilityScreen: At least 50% of clipped cached detailed-Census source km across all windows has a unique plausible match and usable limit; every window/layer/road-class denominator and 50-match review remains visible. The 50% is a prospective engineering screen for data usefulness, not an accuracy/national coverage claim.
goNoGo.failure: Stop and document the exact cap, coverage, scope or matching failure; no national expansion or model cost change.
goNoGo.success: Design and freeze one road-attribute timing policy separately, then specify a bounded nationwide input expansion. Pilot coverage alone does not authorize an active switch or establish arbitrary-origin accuracy.

integration.runtime: A later producer could compile accepted attributes into existing static road-cost payloads with generic class fallback for missing/unsupported/unmatched data. The app would continue to compute offline in TypeScript on Vercel; no road-data request or cloud DB dependency per query. This is a proposed integration, not implemented or qualified.
integration.national: Use a fixed release and deterministic complete CONUS tiling; separately bounded national expansion required. These 21 windows are not national coverage or a router.
integration.gates: Every original 83/35 accuracy/finite/component/missed/tail/individual gate, physical/source/shore/transfer/path checks, <=70 MB function, retained decoded<=162238546 bytes, first packaged estimate<=5 s, API/software/shared-camera review remains. Actual compressed package, memory, matching coverage and accuracy must be measured; no forecast promoted to admission.
integration.storage: Raw GeoParquet/tool environment and provenance stay ignored and excluded from Vercel; preserve ODbL/source attribution and license metadata in later derivatives.

nextAction: Implement and validate the capped offline pilot reader/parser using synthetic local fixtures, resolve/freeze metadata/object identities under the same total network cap, then execute one separately sealed pilot recipe. Current design task performs no road-data acquisition.
scope: Data feasibility only. Existing 83/35 remain observed development references; no extra ORS/Valhalla budget, no named-place routing behavior, traffic truth or national query claim. V9 stays active.
